links.outcome: Reproducibility of locally deployed LLM intelligibility score across repeated runs
links.effect: LLM intelligibility score showed excellent repeatability across five runs (ICC = 0.97, Cronbach's α = 0.98) and strong correlations with ASR error metrics.
links.quote: Importantly, the LLM-derived intelligibility score demonstrated excellent repeatability across five runs (intra-class correlation; ICC = 0.97, Cronbach’s α = 0.98) and showed strong correlations with ASR error metrics.

screen.reason: Evaluates the feasibility, repeatability, and correlation with clinical severity scales of an LLM-derived intelligibility metric for dysarthric speech in Parkinson's disease on a dataset of recorded speech.
